bifrost: springboard/apps/daw/src/lab.rs (loudness only, app-private); springboard/src/media/symfile.rs and mp3.rs (file decode); springboard/audiod/src/main.rs (playback and capture service)
summary: The framework is audio analysis: a session that runs rhythm, key, loudness, pace, structure and instrument-activity analyses over a file or a buffer stream. The SDK has an analysis entry point (sdk/src/music_understanding.rs, analyze_interleaved) that gives rhythm (beats, bars, tempo), key over time, structure boundaries and loudness, tested in music_understanding::tests and music::tests. Pace is a model the session does not run yet, and instrument activity and source separation are not built.

gaps: Pace and section labels: pace is a model in ui/src/music.rs (analyze_pace from a beat grid) that the session does not run yet; structure gives segment boundaries only, with no section labels or phrases.
Instrument activity detection and source separation.
Loudness: the session gives integrated and maximum momentary and short-term LUFS over whole buffers; there is no streaming meter, and true peak is still DAW-only.
No streaming input: analyze_interleaved (sdk/src/music_understanding.rs) takes a whole buffer, and the decoders return whole files.
